{{Quote|Lead, they're in attack formation Echo-3.|Lt. [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 21">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 21|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 21]]</ref>}}
'''Echo-3''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] tactic. It was utilized by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' fleet of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and his [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|command ship]] during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attack on]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. It was also utilized by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] from the [[Brentaal Moonbase]] while moving to engage a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] reconnaissance mission.
